rationale.conceptual: The work uses established DFT/AIMD methods but requires careful construction of the vermiculite surface model (Al substitution, cation placement, water film) and non-trivial analysis of contact layers and binding energies. It is not a simple textbook application but the method is well-documented and the conceptual burden is moderate.
rationale.execution: The pipeline has five sequential steps: model building, DFT optimization, two AIMD simulations (35-40 ps each), contact layer identification, and binding energy calculation. While the simulations are heavy, the orchestration is straightforward and the dependencies are linear. No complex data fetching or multi-tool integration is required beyond CP2K.

difficulty.reasoning: The task involves setting up a realistic vermiculite surface model with cation exchange and running standard DFT/AIMD simulations followed by binding energy analysis. The conceptual difficulty is moderate (established method with some customization), and the pipeline has several sequential steps including AIMD simulations that are computationally demanding but not orchestrally complex.

compute_estimate.reasoning: The simulations involve a small 2×1 supercell with 40 water molecules using DFT (CP2K). This is a CPU-only workload with modest memory requirements (a few GB) and no external datasets; the input structures are defined inline.
